import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_quadloss_b()
    return nothing
end

function quadloss_b(loss, lossb, x, xb, y, yb, z, zb)
    loss[1] = (x ^ 2 * y - 3.0 * y * z) + z ^ 3
    xb = xb + (2x) * (y * lossb[1])
    yb = yb + x ^ 2 * lossb[1]
    yb = yb + (3.0z) * -(lossb[1])
    zb = zb + (3.0y) * -(lossb[1])
    zb = zb + (3 * z ^ 2) * lossb[1]
    lossb[1] = 0.0
    return (xb, yb, zb)
end

function initstacks_quadloss_b_cuda()
    return nothing
end

function quadloss_b_cuda(loss, lossb, x, xb, y, yb, z, zb)
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            loss[1] = (x ^ 2 * y - 3.0 * y * z) + z ^ 3
            xb = xb + (2x) * (y * lossb[1])
            yb = yb + x ^ 2 * lossb[1]
            yb = yb + (3.0z) * -(lossb[1])
            zb = zb + (3.0y) * -(lossb[1])
            zb = zb + (3 * z ^ 2) * lossb[1]
            lossb[1] = 0.0
        end
    return (xb, yb, zb)
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end

_relerr_scalar(a, b) = abs(a - b) / max(abs(a), abs(b), 1.0)
_relerr_arr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b) ./ max.(abs.(a), abs.(b), 1.0))

__base_loss = Float64[0.15427582394459136, 1.9324379523979713, 1.7796738834258903, 0.0453646933305262]
__base_x = 0.26864320942413433
__base_y = 0.17216476272765635
__base_z = -0.588747742030672
__seed_x = [1.6115682581260182, -0.13628774773340627]
__seed_y = [1.379911002456155, 0.0316766271015789]
__seed_z = [-0.8933716556679695, -1.1772189036399894]
__seed_loss = [Float64[-1.158186515834555, -0.019579993571970777, -1.319723185564185, -0.19800734548243396], Float64[2.3676779880977206, -0.3947393203954968, -1.5190225095561334, 0.3738462664783855]]
max_rel_err = 0.0
for __trial in 1:2
  loss_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_loss); loss_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial])
  loss_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_loss)); loss_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial]))
  x_val_cpu = __base_x; x_sh_cpu = __seed_x[__trial]
  x_val_gpu = __base_x; x_sh_gpu = __seed_x[__trial]
  y_val_cpu = __base_y; y_sh_cpu = __seed_y[__trial]
  y_val_gpu = __base_y; y_sh_gpu = __seed_y[__trial]
  z_val_cpu = __base_z; z_sh_cpu = __seed_z[__trial]
  z_val_gpu = __base_z; z_sh_gpu = __seed_z[__trial]
  stacks_cpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_quadloss_b, Any[])
  stacks_gpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_quadloss_b_cuda, Any[])
  ret_cpu = quadloss_b(loss_val_cpu, loss_sh_cpu, x_val_cpu, x_sh_cpu, y_val_cpu, y_sh_cpu, z_val_cpu, z_sh_cpu, stacks_cpu...)
  ret_gpu = quadloss_b_cuda(loss_val_gpu, loss_sh_gpu, x_val_gpu, x_sh_gpu, y_val_gpu, y_sh_gpu, z_val_gpu, z_sh_gpu, stacks_gpu...)
  ret_cpu_t = ret_cpu
  ret_gpu_t = ret_gpu
  local_max = 0.0
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_sh_cpu, Array(loss_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_val_cpu, Array(loss_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_scalar(ret_cpu_t[1], ret_gpu_t[1]))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_scalar(ret_cpu_t[2], ret_gpu_t[2]))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_scalar(ret_cpu_t[3], ret_gpu_t[3]))
  global max_rel_err = max(max_rel_err, local_max)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("ok" => max_rel_err <= 2.5e-14, "max_rel_err" => max_rel_err, "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))))
